title: Compare H₂ and H₂⁻
statement:
Adding one electron to H₂ places it in which orbital in the simple 1s MO model?

[_]{a}

explanations: The bonding level is already full.
Two 1s orbitals combine to sigma-symmetry orbitals.
The occupancy choice is right but the effect is reversed.

hints: Neutral H₂ already has two electrons in σ₁s.
Pauli prevents a third in that orbital.
solution: Neutral H₂ already has two electrons in σ₁s. Pauli prevents a third in that orbital. Use the remaining 1s combination. The new electron is antibonding.
